terra.problem: The line calls Bahurim a city of Benjamin, but the sources locate it near Benjamin’s boundary; they do not establish that it was in Benjamin.
“Hidden in a well” says the wife used a cloth, but 2 Samuel 17:19 says only that she used a covering.
“Shimei asks forgiveness” takes place at the Jordan, not at Bahurim. Shimei was from Bahurim.
“David’s last words on Shimei” does not take place at Bahurim. David identifies Shimei as being from there.
